statement: The ip2region provider answers unavailable, never absent, for an address no database it loaded covers (an IPv6 address without an IPv6 database, or no address), so a DENY on its attributes is decided as on any missing external attribute; a field the database does not know for an address it covers is absent.
guards: ip2region:GeoBlockDecisionTest#a geo block is not stepped around over IPv6
ip2region:GeoBlockDecisionTest#onMissing nomatch lets an unlocatable address through
